asn_lookup.name: asn_lookup
asn_lookup.description: Look up details of an Autonomous System Number (ASN)

asn.description: The AS Number to lookup (e.g., AS6167 or 6167)

mode.description: Environment mode for testing or production

callback.description: Function name for JSONP response format

aiMetadata.description: Look up registration and network details for an Autonomous System Number (ASN), accepting the number with or without the "AS" prefix (e.g. AS6167 or 6167). Use to identify the organization, allocation, or routing info behind an ASN. Read-only lookup; safe to repeat.

bin_lookup.name: bin_lookup
bin_lookup.description: Look up details of a Bank Identification Number (BIN) or Issuer Identification Number (IIN)

bin.description: The BIN/IIN of the card (minimum 6 digits). Can be partial like "456789" or full card number

mode.description: Environment mode for testing or production

userID.description: Identify requests from specific users for monitoring (e.g., email, phone, user ID)

callback.description: Function name for JSONP response format

aiMetadata.description: Look up the issuing bank, card scheme, type, and country behind a payment card from its BIN/IIN (the leading digits). Accepts either the first 6+ digits or a full card number (only the leading digits are used). Use for card validation or fraud-screening enrichment. Read-only lookup; safe to repeat.

ip_lookup.name: ip_lookup
ip_lookup.description: Look up comprehensive information about an IP address including location, ISP, security, and risk factors

ip.description: The IP address to lookup (IPv4 or IPv6)

params.description: Comma-separated list of modules to include: security, currency, timezone, location (e.g., "security,timezone,currency")

mode.description: Environment mode for testing or production

userID.description: Identify requests from specific users for monitoring (e.g., email, phone, user ID)

callback.description: Function name for JSONP response format

aiMetadata.description: Look up geolocation, ISP, timezone, currency, and security/risk signals for an IPv4 or IPv6 address. Optionally narrow the response to specific modules (security, currency, timezone, location) via a comma-separated list. Use to geolocate or fraud-screen an IP. Read-only lookup; safe to repeat.

email_validation.name: email_validation
email_validation.description: Validate email addresses by checking domain validity, detecting disposable emails, and assessing risk factors

mode.description: Environment mode for testing or production

userID.description: Identify requests from specific users for monitoring (e.g., email, phone, user ID)

callback.description: Function name for JSONP response format

aiMetadata.description: Validate and risk-score a single email address, checking domain/MX validity, disposable-email detection, and fraud indicators. Use to verify an email before signup, contact, or fraud screening. Read-only scoring call; safe to repeat.

profanity_detection.name: profanity_detection
profanity_detection.description: Detect offensive or inappropriate language in text using machine learning

text.description: The text to check for profanity

scoreOnly.description: Return only the score and safety status

listBadWords.description: Include a list of bad words found in the text

mode.description: Environment mode for testing or production

callback.description: Function name for JSONP response format

aiMetadata.description: Scan a block of text for offensive or inappropriate language and return a risk/safety assessment. Can return just the score and safety flag, or additionally list the bad words found. Use to moderate user-generated content. Read-only scoring call; safe to repeat.

phone_validation.name: phone_validation
phone_validation.description: Validate phone numbers by checking syntax and assessing validity and operational status

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, GB, FR)

mode.description: Environment mode for testing or production

userID.description: Identify requests from specific users for monitoring (e.g., email, phone, user ID)

callback.description: Function name for JSONP response format

aiMetadata.description: Validate a phone number against its country, checking syntax and reporting validity and operational status. Requires both the phone number (any common format) and the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, FR). Use to verify a phone before contact or fraud screening. Read-only scoring call; safe to repeat.

proxy_connection_detected.name: proxy_connection_detected
proxy_connection_detected.description: Triggers when a new proxy connection is detected

webhookInstructions.description:
To use this trigger, you need to manually set up a webhook in your Greip account:

1. Login to your Greip dashboard.
2. Go to Settings > Integrations > Webhooks.
3. Click on "Add Webhook" or "Create New Webhook".
4. Add the following URL in the **Webhook URL** field:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
5. Select **proxy_detected** from the event types.
6. Click Save to create the webhook.

**Note:** Webhooks are only available for paid subscriptions.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Greip detects an incoming connection from a proxy, Tor, relay, bot, or hosting IP. Delivered via a Greip webhook (proxy_detected event) that must be configured manually in the Greip dashboard.
